text: Healthy living is about much more than just avoiding illness; it's about feeling good in both body and mind. A balanced diet, rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, provides the energy you need to get through the day. Regular exercise, even a simple daily walk, strengthens your heart and improves your mood. Equally important is getting enough sleep—aim for seven to nine hours—to let your body recover and your brain reset. Don't forget your mental health either; taking time to relax or chat with a friend can reduce stress. Finally, a good work-life balance ensures you have time for yourself, making healthy habits easier to sustain long-term. Start small, and build from there.
